characters.name: HIIR MIISU
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte roosade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti ja kollast lipsukest. Suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike pruun siil, pehmete okastega seljal, kandmas väikest rohelist salli. Ümarad mustad silmad ja heatujuline naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: PÄIKESELINE LIIVAKAST
locations.description: A bright and sunny outdoor sandpit area in a park. The sandpit is large with light yellow clean sand. Around the sandpit are lush green grass and a few colorful small playground toys like a red bucket and a blue shovel. In the background, green trees and a clear blue sky are visible. Warm sunlight. Cartoon style.
